stem: What was one result of the creation of the Civilian Conservation Corps (CCC) during the 1930s?

options.label: F
options.text: State governments took over the responsibility of protecting minority rights.

options.label: G
options.text: The federal government was no longer responsible for protecting natural resources.

options.label: H
options.text: State governments could no longer control their budgets.

options.label: J
options.text: The federal government provided aid to people suffering from unemployment.
